rationale: 在 C(基线∪符号召回) 候选集内部用 BGE chunk 嵌入做语义重排，不引入 cross-encoder/LLM。

rerankStrategies.rerankMaxCos: score(file)=max_cosine(queryVec, chunkVec) over chunks with chunk.file==file
rerankStrategies.rerankMeanPool: score(file)=cosine(queryVec, mean(chunkVec) over chunks of file)

fallback: files in C with no chunk coverage keep their C position (sink after scored files)
